label: lab, Playwright
method: Chromium, 390x844 mobile emulation, 4x CPU throttle, Slow-4G (CDP), median of 3 cold loads. LCP/CLS via PerformanceObserver, TBT = sum of (longtask - 50ms) until load + 5s. Both sides are local production builds (next start): Vercel previews are behind SSO, so they can't be measured. Single-machine timings are noisy (about +/-15%).
